name: Philadelphia and the suburbs
title: Storage Systems in Philadelphia & the Suburbs | O'Brien Systems
description: High-density shelving, lockers, casework and museum storage designed and installed in Philadelphia and Montgomery, Bucks, Chester and Delaware counties since 1979.
h1: Storage systems for Philadelphia and the suburbs
lede: Our home market since 1979. We are based in Conshohocken and work across the city and all four suburban counties.
intro: Most of our work over the last four decades has been within an hour of our Conshohocken office. That includes Center City law firms and city agencies, pharmaceutical campuses along Route 202 and Route 422, college libraries on the Main Line, and township and county buildings across the suburbs.
Being close means we can walk the space, measure, and come back with a layout quickly. It also means our service team is nearby after the job is done.
areas: Montgomery County: Conshohocken, King of Prussia, Norristown, Blue Bell, Fort Washington, Horsham, Collegeville, Pottstown
Chester County: Exton, Malvern, West Chester, Kennett Square
Main Line: Bryn Mawr, Villanova, Wayne

name: New Jersey
title: Storage Systems in New Jersey | O'Brien Systems
description: High-density shelving, lockers, casework and records storage installed across South, Central and North Jersey for law firms, counties, pharma, schools and military sites.
lede: From Cherry Hill and Atlantic City to Princeton, Morristown and Newark, New Jersey is our second biggest market.
intro: South Jersey is a short drive from our Conshohocken office, and we have worked there for decades: law firms in Cherry Hill and Voorhees, county offices in Camden, Cape May and Salem counties, and casino and hospitality back-of-house space in Atlantic City.

Farther north we have installed records and file storage for law firms and county governments, high-density and lab storage at pharmaceutical and research sites around Princeton, New Brunswick and Rahway, and storage at military installations in Burlington and Morris counties.
areas: South Jersey: Cherry Hill, Camden, Voorhees, Moorestown, Mount Laurel, Marlton, Pennsauken, Glassboro, Vineland, Salem
Jersey Shore: Atlantic City, Cape May Court House, Toms River, Red Bank, Freehold
Central Jersey: Princeton, Trenton, Lawrenceville, Ewing, Hightstown, Bordentown, New Brunswick, Edison, Bridgewater
North Jersey: Morristown, Newark, Florham Park, Short Hills, Rahway, Kenilworth

name: Delaware
title: Storage Systems in Delaware | O'Brien Systems
description: High-density file storage, shelving, lockers and museum storage installed in Wilmington, Newark and across Delaware for law firms, banks, hospitals and museums.
lede: Wilmington is about 40 minutes from our Conshohocken office, and we work across the state.
intro: Delaware's law firms and banks keep a lot of paper, and high-density file storage is a large share of our work there. We have also moved and rebuilt file rooms when firms relocate, and set up mailrooms and records centers for financial companies.
Beyond offices, we have installed collections storage for museums and historic estates in the Brandywine Valley, storage for hospitals and research labs, and records storage for state offices.

name: Baltimore, Washington DC and Virginia
title: Storage Systems in Baltimore, Washington DC & Virginia | O'Brien Systems
description: Museum collections storage, high-density shelving and secure storage installed for museums, federal agencies, military sites, law firms and biopharma in Maryland, DC and Virginia.
h1: Storage systems in Baltimore, Washington DC and Virginia
lede: Museums, federal agencies, military installations and law firms from Aberdeen to Richmond.
intro: Much of our work in this region is collections storage: cabinets, high-density storage and art racks for museums and cultural institutions in Washington and Baltimore. Those projects follow conservation requirements closely, and we plan them with collections staff, architects and general contractors from the start.

We have also installed storage at military and federal sites in Maryland and Virginia, file systems for law firms in Washington, Baltimore and Northern Virginia, and storage for biopharma labs in Montgomery County, Maryland.

name: Central, Eastern and Western Pennsylvania
title: Storage Systems in Harrisburg, Lancaster, Reading & Pittsburgh | O'Brien Systems
description: High-density shelving, records storage, lockers and museum storage installed across Pennsylvania: Harrisburg, Lancaster, Reading, the Lehigh Valley, Scranton, Wilkes-Barre and Pittsburgh.
lede: County courthouses, state offices, museums and law firms from Reading and Harrisburg to Wilkes-Barre and Pittsburgh.
intro: Outside the Philadelphia area, much of our Pennsylvania work is for county governments and courts. Records rooms, prothonotary and clerk of courts offices and domestic relations offices all run out of space, and high-density storage is often the fix that avoids an addition.

We have also installed collections storage for museums and historical societies, file systems for law firms in Harrisburg and Pittsburgh, and storage at military and state facilities in Central and Northeastern Pennsylvania.

name: New York and New England
title: Storage Systems in New York & New England | O'Brien Systems
description: Museum collections storage, high-density shelving and file systems installed for museums, law firms, retailers, colleges and courts in New York, Connecticut, Massachusetts and Rhode Island.
h1: Storage systems in New York and New England
lede: Museums, law firms, retailers and colleges from Manhattan and Brooklyn to Boston and Providence.
intro: In New York City our work has included collections storage for major museums, file and records systems for law firms, and back-of-house storage for retail stores. Upstate, we have installed storage for museums, colleges and a military academy.
In New England we have worked for museums and historical societies, courthouses, banks and pharmaceutical companies in Connecticut, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Vermont and Maine.
